picks.editorial_note: Purdue leading two of the first 278 DOE Genesis Mission awards signals a flagship national push to embed AI directly into frontier scientific discovery, from particle physics data streams to broader lab workflows.
picks.title: 2 Purdue AI research projects selected among the first Genesis Mission awards

picks.editorial_note: Using generative AI to design entirely novel proteins never seen in nature, building on Nobel laureate David Baker's computational protein engineering techniques, represents a genuine frontier-science advance with broad biomedical potential.
picks.title: UCLA bioengineer Jason Zhang deploys AI to create proteins never before seen in nature

picks.editorial_note: A £20 million MRC-funded hub led by Cambridge combining stem cell models with AI to accelerate drug development is a substantial, well-funded bet on AI-driven biomedicine.
picks.title: Cambridge to lead new £20m MRC Hub to transform development of new medicines using stem cells and AI

picks.editorial_note: RoboDojo, built with nearly 20 global universities including UC Berkeley and Tsinghua, establishes a new international standard for evaluating embodied AI robot manipulation, a foundational contribution for the field.
picks.title: HKU Pioneers "RoboDojo": The First Hong Kong-Led Unified Benchmark for Embodied AI, Setting New Global Standards for Robot Reliability - Press Releases - Media - HKU

picks.editorial_note: A three-way collaboration between SRI, Mayo Clinic, and the University of Florida, backed by ARPA-H, applies AI-guided smart glasses to real clinical procedures, an unusually concrete example of AI improving frontline healthcare delivery.
picks.title: AI guides healthcare workers through blood draws, intubation, and more - SRI

picks.editorial_note: Purdue's role in NSF Integrated Data Systems and Services grants totaling over $42 million builds national-scale AI and data cyberinfrastructure that will underpin research well beyond Purdue itself.

picks.editorial_note: UC Riverside's DOE Genesis Mission awards apply AI to quantum computing error correction and cross-lab data sharing, extending the national initiative's reach into two technically demanding problem areas.
picks.title: UCR researchers join DOE effort to speed scientific discovery

picks.editorial_note: Haim Sompolinsky's Dirac Medal recognizes foundational statistical-mechanics work underlying modern neural network theory, a high-profile validation of the theoretical science behind AI.
picks.title: The Hebrew University of Jerusalem Congratulates Prof. Haim Sompolinsky on Receiving the 2026 Dirac Medal

picks.editorial_note: University of Alabama's DOE Genesis Mission partnership with Fermilab to build AI tools for sifting high-energy physics data extends the same national initiative into large-scale experimental science.
picks.title: AI meets particle physics in UA-Led Department of Energy project

picks.editorial_note: A university-born startup, FastFlowLM, being absorbed by semiconductor giant AMD to optimize NPU usage for large language models shows academic AI research translating directly into industry-scale chip technology.
